items.source: The format of META-INF/spring.schemas is a properties file where each line should be of the form systemId=schema-location where schema-location should also be a schema file in the classpath. Since systemId is commonly a URL, one must be careful to escape any ':' characters which are treated as delimiters in properties files.
items.translation: `META-INF/spring.schemas` 的格式是一个属性文件，其中每一行都应遵循 `systemId=schema-location` 的形式，且 `schema-location` 也应是类路径中的模式文件。由于 `systemId` 通常是 URL，必须小心转义被视为属性文件中分隔符的冒号（':'）字符。

items.source: The pattern for the mapping files can be overridden using the PluggableSchemaResolver(ClassLoader, String) constructor.
items.translation: 映射文件的模式可以通过 `PluggableSchemaResolver(ClassLoader, String)` 构造函数进行覆盖。

items.source: By default, this class will look for mapping files in the classpath using the pattern: META-INF/spring.schemas allowing for multiple files to exist on the classpath at any one time.
items.translation: 默认情况下，该类将在类路径中查找映射文件，使用的模式为：META-INF/spring.schemas，允许在类路径上同时存在多个此类文件。

items.source:
Loads the schema URL → schema file location mappings using the default
mapping file pattern "META-INF/spring.schemas".
items.translation: 使用默认映射文件模式"META-INF/spring.schemas"加载架构 URL 到架构文件位置的映射。

items.source:
Loads the schema URL → schema file location mappings using the given
mapping file pattern.
items.translation: 使用给定的映射文件模式加载架构 URL 到架构文件位置的映射。

items.source:
The location of the file that defines schema mappings.
Can be present in multiple JAR files.
items.translation:
定义模式映射的文件所在位置。
可能存在于多个 JAR 文件中。

items.source: classLoader - the ClassLoader to use for loading (can be null to use the default ClassLoader)
items.translation: classLoader - 用于加载类的 ClassLoader（可以设为 null 以使用默认 ClassLoader）

items.source: schemaMappingsLocation - the location of the file that defines schema mappings (must not be empty)
items.translation: schemaMappingsLocation - 定义模式映射的文件位置（不能为空）
